title: TimePicker configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.TimePickerAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

AllowInput.description: Stores the ability to allow inputs to be editable or not

DisableMobile.description: Stores the ability to disable the mobile flatpickr behavior. False is the default provider option

FirstWeekDay.description: First day of the week (0 = Sunday); forwarded to the provider locale.

InitialTime.description: Time selected when the picker is built (HH:mm).

Is24Hours.description: Uses a 24-hour clock; false shows an AM/PM selector.

OnChangeEventCallback.description: Store the OnChange Event callback to be defined in the specific context for each Flatpickr mode (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

OnCloseEventCallback.description: Store the OnClose callback to be defined to the Flatpicker config instance (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

OnOpenEventCallback.description: Store the OnOpen callback to be defined to the Flatpicker config instance (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

ServerDateFormat.description: Store the Server Date format that will be used to casting the selected dates into a knowned date by/for Flatpickr

TimeFormat.description: Display format of the selected time.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
